name: Daily Stand-up
description: Per-person updates: done, doing next, blocked.
outline: Group the notes per speaker or participant, using the names that were spoken.
For each person list what they finished, what they will do next, and any blocker, as short bullets.
Collect all blockers again in one list at the end, with who could unblock them if mentioned.
Skip small talk and keep each bullet to one line.
example:
### Sam
- Done: login bug fixed
- Next: payment tests
- Blocked: waiting for API keys

## Blockers
- API keys (Sam)
